Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production lens-flare texture for additive camera-facing sprites in a real-time 3D night-driving game.
Create ONE isolated optical light-effect sprite, square 1024x1024 RGBA image with a genuinely transparent background, not a checkerboard or a black backdrop.
Composition: optical center exactly at the center of the canvas; smooth luminous falloff into zero opacity; all visible energy contained inside the central 80 percent of the canvas, with generous fully transparent padding on all four sides. Soft continuous gradients with subtle realistic optical texture.
Constraints: no scene, no lamp, no pole, no objects, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark, no tiled sheet, no hard cutout edges, no lens dirt, no satellite ghosts, no extra off-center lights. This is an emission sprite viewed front-on, not a 3D model render.
Primary request: a realistic compact warm sodium streetlight corona. A tiny brilliant creamy-white center smoothly dissolves into warm pale yellow and subdued amber-orange atmospheric glow. Round radially smooth soft glow, luminous photographic glare, with slightly organic fine scattering. Keep the source concentrated and the outer glow much dimmer. No starburst rays, no streak, no distinct ring. This layer supplies the core and glow of a warm street lamp.
